definitions.explanation: Something that causes mental distress or preoccupation. Personal troubles or difficulties that one struggles with.

examples.japanese: {悩|なや}みがあったら、いつでも{相談|そうだん}してね。
examples.english: If you have any worries, feel free to talk to me anytime.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}の{悩|なや}みを{抱|かか}えている。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{人間関係|にんげんかんけい}の{悩|なや}みが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: She has a lot of troubles with interpersonal relationships.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{悩|なや}みがある (to have worries)
・{悩|なや}みを{抱|かか}える (to carry/have worries)
・{悩|なや}みを{相談|そうだん}する (to consult about one's worries)
・{悩|なや}みを{打|う}ち{明|あ}ける (to confide one's troubles)
・{悩|なや}みの{種|たね} (source of worry, cause of trouble)

TYPES OF {悩|なや}み:
・{仕事|しごと}の{悩|なや}み (work troubles)
・{人間関係|にんげんかんけい}の{悩|なや}み (relationship troubles)
・{健康|けんこう}の{悩|なや}み (health concerns)
・{贅沢|ぜいたく}な{悩|なや}み (a luxury problem, first-world problem)

RELATED WORDS:
・{悩|なや}む (to worry, to be troubled - verb)
・{心配|しんぱい} (worry, anxiety - more about specific concerns)
・{苦悩|くのう} (anguish, suffering - more intense)
